about: Work queue for the local agent (see HANDOFF.md). Written by the cloud orchestrator at the end of every iteration. The local agent never edits this file; it records progress in docs/local-done.json. Bump a task's rev when its instructions change so a blocked task is retried.

cloud.summary: Iteration 1 is planning the first full version of the site. No stations, videos or narration exist yet.

tasks.title: Check the local toolchain
tasks.why: Every later task needs node, git push access, ffmpeg and manim; Doppler for audio.
steps: Run `node tools/local/check.mjs --tools` and read the tool report.

If anything is missing, do not try to install it from an unattended run (Homebrew needs the student). Record the task as blocked with needs_from_student: "Run `bash tools/local/setup.sh` and accept the install for <missing tools>."
done_when: `node tools/local/check.mjs --tools` reports node, git, npm, ffmpeg, doppler, claude and manim as ok

tasks.title: Make the OpenRouter audio calls work (ElevenLabs speech, Lyria music)
tasks.why: tools/media/generate-audio.mjs was written in the cloud without access to openrouter.ai, so its audio requests are untested.
steps: List secret names (never values): `bash tools/local/run.sh secret-names`. If the provisioning (admin) key has a name the script does not look for, set "keyVar" in media/audio-config.json.
List audio-capable models: `bash tools/local/run.sh audio --list-models`. Pick the ElevenLabs speech model and the Google Lyria music model.

Read OpenRouter's current documentation (WebFetch on openrouter.ai/docs) for requesting audio output from those models, and fix openrouterAudio() in tools/media/generate-audio.mjs so the documented request shape is tried first.

Test in a scratch folder so nothing in media/ changes: create .local/audio-test/site/test.json with one short speech segment and a music prompt of 20 seconds, then `bash tools/local/run.sh audio --narration-dir .local/audio-test --audio-dir .local/audio-test/out --tts-model <id> --music-model <id>`. Check both files with ffprobe (non-zero duration, audio stream present).

Save the choices in media/audio-config.json: voice (warm, clear, unhurried; suited to explaining maths the night before a test), ttsModel, musicModel, limitUsd 5. Commit tools/media and media/audio-config.json.
done_when: one speech clip and one music clip were generated through OpenRouter and are valid audio
media/audio-config.json records the voice and both models
the temporary OpenRouter key was deleted (the script prints 'Deleted the temporary OpenRouter key.')
